text:
ANTIFRAUD::client_id
Description
This iRules command returns client id collected on client side.
Syntax
ANTIFRAUD
::
client_id
Examples
when
ANTIFRAUD_ALERT
{
log
local0.
"client id: [ANTIFRAUD::client_id]."
}
Related Information
Valid Events:
ANTIFRAUD_ALERT
Introduced: BIGIP-15.0.0
